topic: RAII and Smart Pointers (unique_ptr and shared_ptr)
expectedQuizObjectives: Explain how unique_ptr enforces exclusive ownership without runtime overhead
Describe how shared_ptr reference counting works and how weak_ptr breaks cycles
Demonstrate how RAII guarantees exception safety
expectedClaims: Acquires resources in constructor and releases them deterministically in destructor
std::unique_ptr provides exclusive zero-overhead ownership and prevents copying
std::weak_ptr prevents reference count cycles in shared pointer graphs

topic: Rvalue References, Move Semantics, and std::move
expectedQuizObjectives: Explain why std::move does not move anything at runtime
Contrast copy constructor with move constructor resource allocation
Identify when an rvalue reference binds to an expression
expectedClaims: std::move is an unconditional static_cast to rvalue reference and emits no runtime machine code by itself
Move semantics transfer ownership of pointers and buffer handles from expiring objects
